name: scienpay-monorepo
description: Sistema de Control de Pagos y Asignaciones para Equipos de Ciencia

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@scienpay/api && npm run build --workspace=@scienpay/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@scienpay/api && npm run test:integration --workspace=@scienpay/api
scripts.e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@scienpay/api && npm run e2e --workspace=@scienpay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

author: Scienpay Team
